newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks lose initial gains and end negative.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks lose initial gains and end negative.

text.p: Madrid stocks lost initial market gains Thursday afternoon, ending lower as the general mood turned negative.

"The Spanish stock market is overvalued for fundamental reasons..so there are people looking for alternative markets, like the Italian one...but the buying from domestic investment trusts is offering very good support," a Madrid-based dealer said.
The general index lost 7.20 points, or 1.15 percent to 618.32, while Ibex-35 shed 101 points, or 1.42 percent to 7.034.78.
"The market is entering a possible correction phase with the Ibex offering strong resistance above 7,150 points," another dealer in Madrid said.
The market was also hurt by news JP Morgan Securities Ltd was dowgrading the Spanish equity market to neutral from overweight due to more limited upside to earnings forecasts.

Telefonica lost 120 pesetas to 4,315, while Repsol was down 60 to 6,510, but BCH outperformed the market gaining 0.82 percent or 50 pesetas to 6,150 pesetas on talk it would soon approve a share split.
